title: NIST CFReDS Hacking Case: source-grounded 31-question development reference
contract_notes: All 31 original public prompts are retained without replacement. Every expected answer is source-bound or has an explicit reproducible representation transformation.
This is a new typed development rubric using the neutral deterministic scorer, not a historical Mulder prose grading or a Lean proof of the answer key.

All questions are scorable at the published answer precision under these explicit conventions. Investigative procedures, attribution, completeness and observation authenticity remain outside scalar agreement.
Versions/capabilities, scanner details, supporting paths, reasoning and other evidence go outside the scored answer unless the public schema requests them.

Source snapshots and derivation tests establish transcription integrity and reproducibility, not independent semantic correctness. No source answer was changed to fit application facts or model outputs.
